editorial_thesis: Today’s strongest practical signal is a move from novelty to maintenance: agent SDKs absorb generic plumbing, knowledge systems are judged by freshness, and network engineering remains the reliability substrate beneath remote automation.

topic_groups.title: Agent Harnesses
topic_groups.selection_rationale: Fresh uncovered guidance indicates generic tool plumbing is becoming table stakes, leaving governed domain actions as the differentiator.

sources.title: How Building AI Agents Has Changed in 2026
sources.why_selected: It documents the shift from rebuilding generic tools to designing the harness and domain actions.
sources.usefulness: Use it to audit Buildn workflows for duplicated tool and retrieval infrastructure.

topic_groups.title: Knowledge Maintenance
topic_groups.selection_rationale: Coverage history has emphasized agent execution but not enough on freshness and in-place maintenance of useful records.

sources.title: Best personal knowledge management tools in 2026
sources.why_selected: It raises the bar from storing notes to capturing work and updating existing knowledge.
sources.usefulness: Apply the model to ledgers, decisions, client briefs, and agent context.

topic_groups.title: Edge Reliability
topic_groups.selection_rationale: A deliberately under-covered infrastructure lane: reliable agent delivery depends on protocol parity, global routing, and observable failure handling.

sources.title: The Technical Challenges of Building Cloudflare WARP
sources.why_selected: It exposes the network primitives behind resilient global client and automation paths.
sources.usefulness: Turn dual-stack, regional, retry, and fallback checks into integration acceptance criteria.
